title: malva parviflora var. oxyloba
intro: Malva parviflora var. oxyloba, commonly known as the small mallow, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to alleviate various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malva parviflora var. oxyloba are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
